dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible as a complex network of thin, light-toned filamentary perimeters forming irregular, interlocking 'O' and 'C' shapes. The geometry shows a sharp high-contrast transition from the dark-grey exterior pelt to the light-grey boundary lines, defining several prominent closed-loop structures on the mid-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of small, high-intensity white punctate markings. These are localized primarily as asymmetrical clusters in the anterior neck region and scattered sparsely within the larger ringed patterns on the lateral torso.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest and most distinct macro-annuli on the mid-lateral surface form an elongated scalene triangle, with the primary axis oriented cranio-caudally parallel to the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a highly visible, bright red/orange artificial tracking device or satellite tag affixed to the dorsal midline, positioned approximately one-quarter of the body length from the anterior extremity.
